title: Listing icon and feature graphic
check: tools/store/render-store-assets.ps1 -Check: renders into a scratch folder and compares the decoded pixels of both graphics, the landing social card and the site icon copy with the committed files; self-test tools/store/test-render-store-assets.ps1 (S0036)
notes: Render targets of the launcher glyph, never edited by hand. The drift check is the -Check mode of the generator (S0036); it compares decoded pixels, not PNG bytes, because the encoder belongs to the Windows build.

title: READMEs of the repository tools
Ticket specifications
notes: PLAN/Sxxxx_<slug>.md, the ticket scheme declared in CLAUDE.md section 4; the Status line is written only through spec_catalog/update, the body by hand.

title: Evidence the harness keeps beside a ticket
notes: The harness copies the scratch evidence a ticket cites from temp/<ticket>/ when the ticket leaves Draft; a copy of scratch, not a document to edit.

title: Ticket template
Ticket journal, its archive and the burned ids
notes: The home of ticket status; written only through spec_catalog/insert, update, close and archive, never by hand.

title: Release package plan - work remaining, ready and shipped history
generator: harness Sync-ReleaseQueue, called by every spec_catalog mutation
notes: Package headings and line order are the owner's; no script reorders them (CLAUDE.md section 4).

title: Probe baseline - tickets allowed in BlockNeedUserTest without a probe
notes: Belongs to the harness probe gate.

title: Archived tickets - frozen archive
notes: A frozen archive (DOC-INTERNAL-QUALITY item Q): finished records kept as written, so the links inside them are not judged; links into them must resolve and the files stay listed.
